business_problem: Wuxi Rural Commercial Bank needed to turn its historical data into practical AI risk capability, but it lacked deep internal AI talent and could not afford a long, high-cost platform build for machine-learning use cases such as credit assessment.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Wuxi Rural Commercial Bank deployed an AI training appliance that connected the bank's internal big-data platform with external third-party data and separated development, testing, and production workflows. In production, upstream external and internal data are cleaned and processed on the bank's big-data platform. In the development and test zone, those curated datasets are extracted into the AI appliance to train and repeatedly refine credit models. Once validated, the models are exposed back to the bank's loan and admission systems through automated prediction interfaces. This arrangement let the bank stand up a full machine-learning loop quickly: data preparation, model training, iterative tuning, deployment, and real-time scoring all sit on one controlled stack. The first live use case focused on credit access and rating, giving the bank a practical template it can later extend into anti-fraud and credit-limit scenarios.

solution_components.name: AI Training Appliance
solution_components.role: Hosts model training, tuning, and inference workflows for the bank's machine-learning use cases.

solution_components.name: Big Data Platform
solution_components.role: Processes and prepares internal banking data before it is exported into the model-training environment.

solution_components.name: External Data Integration Gateway
solution_components.role: Brings third-party data into the bank's controlled data-processing flow so models can use broader signals.

solution_components.name: Credit Rating Model Service
solution_components.role: Returns automated risk predictions to loan-processing systems after models are deployed.

data_flow: Third-party external data and the bank's internal data are combined and processed on the big-data platform, then exported into the AI appliance for training and tuning. Once the credit models are validated, they are published back to the bank's business systems, where loan workflows call the scoring interface for automated predictions in production.
business_outcome: The bank established a fast, low-overhead machine-learning foundation for credit risk decisions, improved recall without reducing approval quality, and created a deployable AI pattern it can extend into future fraud and credit-limit use cases.
metrics: A working model was built within 2 weeks.
The first production module was delivered in 3 months.
